_help: Edit the values, save, and restart app.py. Anything you leave out uses the default. Values marked CHECK are guesses: replace them with yours.

cube._connection_help: CHECK. A serial port ('COM8' on Windows, '/dev/ttyACM0' on Linux) or a network address like 'udpin:0.0.0.0:14550'.

joystick._disarm_help: true = while no joystick is plugged in the vehicle is kept disarmed (safety). Set false only for bench tests without a joystick.

web._host_help: 0.0.0.0 = other computers on the network can open the dashboard too. 127.0.0.1 = only this computer.

jetson._login_help: Host, username and password default to JETSON_IP, JETSON_USER and JETSON_PASS near the top of app.py. You can override them here; JETSON_PASSWORD overrides the password.
jetson._cmd_help: start_cmd runs automatically after SSH connects and must return at once. Adjust start/stop/check commands if your camera script differs.
jetson.temps_cmd: for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do [ -e "$z/temp" ] && [ -e "$z/type" ] || continue; t=$(cat "$z/type"); case "$t" in cpu-thermal|gpu-thermal|CPU-therm|GPU-therm) echo "$t $(cat "$z/temp")";; esac; done
jetson._temps_help: The CPU and GPU temperature command prints sensor name and millidegrees; readings update immediately after SSH connects and then every second.
jetson.fan_auto_cmd: found=0; for f in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/pwm1_enable; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo 2 > "$f" || exit 1; found=1; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'No hwmon pwm1_enable found; automatic mode is unsupported' >&2; exit 1; }; echo 'Jetson automatic fan control enabled'
jetson.fan_manual_cmd: found=0; for f in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/pwm1; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; enable="${f}_enable"; if [ -e "$enable" ]; then echo 1 > "$enable" || exit 1; fi; echo {pwm} > "$f" || exit 1; found=1; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'No hwmon pwm1 found' >&2; exit 1; }; echo 'Manual fan set to {percent}% (PWM {pwm}/255)'
jetson.fan_cmd: found=0; for f in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/pwm1; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; enable="${f}_enable"; if [ -e "$enable" ]; then echo 1 > "$enable" || exit 1; fi; echo {pwm} > "$f" && found=1; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'No hwmon pwm1 found' >&2; exit 1; }; echo 'Fan set to {percent}% (PWM {pwm}/255)'
jetson._fan_help: Fan defaults to Jetson automatic control using pwm1_enable=2. Manual mode uses pwm1_enable=1 and fan_cmd.
jetson._camera_help: The dashboard connects camera streams directly at http://host:port/stream. Change these if your stream ports or path differ.
